easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
description:
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting The Notary Hobbits.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat.
